newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Profit news boosts NAB shares.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Profit news boosts NAB shares.

text.p: Shares in National Australia Bank Ltd rose 11 cents to a five-week high of A$15.12 in early trading after the bank released first quarter results.
The bank reported a 13.5 percent rise in net profit to A$582 million for the three months to December 31.

NAB managing director Don Argus cited cost containment, strong credit management and financial products marketing as responsible for earnings growth, although he cautioned that interest rate margins remained under pressure in all markets.
Brokers said the result had been pleasing to the market.

"It was very well received in the market and it has inspired the stock to post some strong gains this morning," said a Brisbane-based dealer. By 12.05 p.m. (0105 GMT), NAB shares were 31 cents higher at A$15.32 on turnover of 4.07 million shares.
